quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 88,039 million (+8.8%), operating profit JPY 15,262 million (+8.0%), ordinary profit JPY 14,900 million (+6.6%), net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 11,173 million (+8.2%); results beat the company's FY targets of net sales JPY 80,000 million, operating profit JPY 10,500 million and net profit JPY 7,500 million, mainly because advanced-packaging equipment for semiconductor back-end did well on demand for generative-AI GPUs; ROS 17.3% (target 13.1%), ROE 21.7% (target 15.8%). Sales rose in semiconductors and fell in FPD and in distribution equipment (the new-banknote replacement demand ended). By product: SPE (semiconductor) sales JPY 75,825 million (JPY 62,764 million the year before), FPD JPY 3,817 million (JPY 5,780 million). Domestic sales JPY 21,306 million (-21.4%, 24.2% of sales), overseas JPY 66,733 million (+24.0%, 75.8%); by customer location Japan JPY 21,306 million, China JPY 25,932 million, Taiwan JPY 35,929 million, USA JPY 2,691 million, other JPY 2,179 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 88,039 million (+8.8%); operating profit JPY 15,262 million (+8.0%); SPE sales JPY 75,825 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mechatronics Systems segment (bonders, vacuum equipment), year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, management's analysis): sales JPY 31,397 million (+37.9%) and segment profit JPY 7,811 million (+68.0%), as equipment for advanced packaging in semiconductor back-end grew sharply on rising demand for generative-AI GPUs, while FPD back-end and vacuum application equipment were weak; orders JPY 30,513 million (+72.7%) as advanced-packaging equipment orders rose sharply on continued strong generative-AI GPU demand. Segment SPE sales JPY 29,502 million (JPY 19,278 million the year before). For the year ending March 2027 management states it will keep working to further expand the share of its bonders for advanced packaging in the module process.
quarterly_data.figure: Mechatronics Systems sales JPY 31,397 million (+37.9%); segment profit JPY 7,811 million (+68.0%); orders JPY 30,513 million (+72.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): Fine Mechatronics (wafer / mask cleaning, etching and ashing equipment, FPD wet equipment) sales JPY 52,213 million (+3.7%), segment profit JPY 8,090 million (-9.0%) - in semiconductor front-end, logic / foundry equipment was steady but mask and power-device equipment were weak, so equipment sales fell, offset by maintenance / service; FPD front-end was weak; profit fell on lower equipment sales and higher SG&A from development and other growth investment; orders JPY 52,788 million (+16.5%). Segment SPE sales JPY 46,323 million. For the year ending March 2027 management will focus on selling the two models newly added to its global-niche-top (GNT) products and accelerate development of new models. Distribution Equipment Systems sales JPY 2,595 million (-56.5%), profit JPY 64 million (-95.7%); Real Estate Rental sales JPY 1,832 million, profit JPY 359 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Fine Mechatronics sales JPY 52,213 million (+3.7%); segment profit JPY 8,090 million (-9.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Orders and production, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, at selling prices): orders received JPY 87,744 million (+25.8%; 125.8% of the prior year) - Fine Mechatronics JPY 52,788 million, Mechatronics Systems JPY 30,513 million (172.7%), Distribution Equipment JPY 2,610 million; order backlog at year end JPY 48,331 million (99.4% of the prior year) - Fine Mechatronics JPY 38,761 million (101.5%), Mechatronics Systems JPY 7,860 million (89.9%), Distribution Equipment JPY 1,709 million. Production JPY 64,999 million (109.3%) - Fine Mechatronics JPY 30,246 million (95.1%), Mechatronics Systems JPY 33,100 million (146.2%), Distribution Equipment JPY 1,652 million (33.0%). Semiconductor front-end orders were steady, back-end orders far exceeded the strong prior year, and maintenance / service orders were steady.
quarterly_data.figure: Orders JPY 87,744 million (+25.8%); order backlog JPY 48,331 million (99.4% of prior year)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's outlook and plan (annual securities report): the company expects AI demand to keep leading the market, with capex for logic / foundry and memory, centred on AI uses, continuing and expanding; over the medium to long term it expects capex for logic / foundry, memory, power devices and wafers all to progress steadily. It is running a new medium-term management plan (2026-2028 in the company's own fiscal-year numbering), Phase 2 toward 'Shibaura Vision 2033', themed on harvesting Phase 1 investments and continuing development, with four pillars led by 'sustainable growth as an SPE player' and continued strategic development investment; it aims to expand its global-niche-top products and its applications, customers and regions using its core cleaning, etching and bonding technologies.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): group R&D expense JPY 3,950 million, including JPY 1,136 million of company-wide elemental technology development; about 310 R&D staff; works with the Toshiba group and business partners. Fine Mechatronics (JPY 1,517 million): single-wafer nitride-film wet etching equipment, wafer cleaning equipment, chemical dry etching equipment, mask wet cleaning and mask dry etching equipment, and a wet-etching spin system for panels for advanced packaging. Mechatronics Systems (JPY 1,035 million): next-generation high-precision bonding equipment for advanced packaging, and sputtering equipment for electronic components. Distribution Equipment (JPY 261 million): cloud-based ticket machines with stronger cashless-payment security.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expense JPY 3,950 million; Mechatronics Systems R&D JPY 1,035 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 10,964 million, centred on SPE - Fine Mechatronics JPY 8,523 million (a new R&D building for semiconductor equipment and evaluation tools: wafer inspection equipment, a new phosphoric-acid etching tool, mask cleaning equipment), Mechatronics Systems JPY 2,128 million (evaluation tools for high-precision bonders). The new R&D building at the Yokohama site has operated since August 2025 and the expanded clean room at the Sagamino site since April 2024; R&D-related investment over the previous medium-term plan (2023-2025 in the company's own fiscal-year numbering) totalled JPY 231 hundred million against a JPY 200 hundred million target. Planned new / expanded production and R&D facilities, both April 2026 to March 2027: Yokohama site (Fine Mechatronics, Real Estate) JPY 3,111 million; Sagamino site, Ebina, Kanagawa (Mechatronics Systems) JPY 2,582 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 10,964 million; planned Yokohama JPY 3,111 million and Sagamino JPY 2,582 million (April 2026 - March 2027)
